text: Let me show you what I want to do with G2, alongside T3 Code.
T3 Code separates settled work from threads that need your input.
Agents build, test, and merge under repo rules.
Here, I’m moving our mobile Sync API to version two.
But older clients still read version one cursors.
Retire version one now, and those clients lose sync.
G2 could show me just that decision.
With R1, I’d confirm: keep v1 for one release.
Agents add compatibility and regression-test both versions.
Then they merge the pull request under policy.
The thread is settled. No routine approvals.
Only the decisions that need you.
That’s what I want to build with Even Realities.
